title: Better Ominous Trial Key
description: Allows the Ominous Trial Key to be craftable
body:
This Mod Allows the Ominous Trial Key to be craftable from one Trial Key and an Ominous Bottle!


 ![Ominous Trial Key Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/221a89191a7b4e66e89869ef609f12e7f1e12f94.png)
